response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, including Java and JVM-related work in past roles, but lacks explicit, recent, or deep focus on enterprise Java/Kotlin tooling, Spring, or IDE internals — his recent work is heavily TypeScript/Node.js and DLang focused, with minimal evidence of IDE or JVM tooling contributions.
strengths: Proven experience with Java in past roles (e.g., National Instruments, Altom)
Strong open-source contributions and tooling mindset (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Excellent communication and teaching background (workshops, talks, CI/CD advocacy)
concerns: Recent work is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, not JVM ecosystems
No clear evidence of Spring, Hibernate, or IDE internals experience in last 5 years
Limited visibility into large-scale enterprise IDE or build tool integration projects
